name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.53-beta “Paris” (build 54): the linked submission.
• Every exhibit in the bundle is linked from the submission — PDFs open at the cited page, other files (videos, spreadsheets) in their own app.
• Paragraph citations like “para 4.2” now find numbered paragraphs in a column, skipping tables of contents.
• Saving the submission as PDF from Word no longer freezes the wizard; a progress bar shows while Word works.
• New option: relink the citations in the open Word submission to the bundled files (relative links), without renumbering.
